join voize
Give time back to those who care
At voize, we believe every frontline worker should be free of admin work to focus on what really matters: people. That’s why we’re building the leading AI companion for nurses – technology that creates more time for care.
Open positions
Nurses are at the heart of healthcare, 
yet overwhelmed by manual tasks and complex systems that pull 
them away from patients.  At voize, we are starting here - tackling the most urgent challenges in frontline work. 
We build an AI companion for nurses that takes over administrative tasks, starting with documentation and expanding to all workflows.
How it started
It all started with a simple realization: caregivers spend too much time documenting, and not enough time caring. When Marcel and Fabio’s grandfather moved into a nursing home, they saw it firsthand and decided to change it.
That’s why they began building voize, the AI companion that gives nurses their time back. 
Today, over 180,000 nurses use voize to focus on what truly matters - human connection. Join the team transforming care.

Our values
How we operate at voize
Care, Always
We care deeply about our users, teammates, and the work we do. We give context, think ahead, and make it easier for others to succeed.
This is how we treat each other.
Put Users First
We put our users at the center of everything. We anticipate their needs, show empathy, and design solutions that free their time for what truly matters.
This is how we serve.
Turn Complexity into Clarity
We make the complex simple — 
in our product, language, and processes. Simplicity helps others thrive.
This is how we create impact.
Aim for Epic
We challenge the status quo, stay curious, and deliver solutions that matter. We aim higher, learn faster, and make an impact.
This is how we set the bar.
Act with Urgency
We act quickly on what truly matters. We experiment, iterate, 
and deliver results without compromising quality.
This is how we get things done.
Own the Outcome
We take initiative and embrace responsibility for results. We make bold decisions, learn from failures, and come back stronger.
This is how we lead ourselves.
find your purpose
Working at voize
At voize, we work hard on meaningful problems but it’s not all about work. We make time to connect, celebrate, and recharge together.
company benefits
Your Perks
Imagine a workplace where your ideas shape the future of caregiving. Where innovation meets empathy, and every day is an opportunity to make a difference.

Flexible work arrangements and remote-friendly policies
Results matter. We trust you to own your schedule – Work from where you do your best thinking, whether that's from our office or your home. Or use some of your remote working days to work from a different EU country. voize offers you a lot of flexibility to find your best work set-up.
Collaborative, cross-functional teams
Forget silos. At our company, marketing collaborates with customer success, designers challenge product managers, and everyone has a seat at the table. The best ideas win – no matter where they come from.
‍
30 vacation days + your birthday off
Recharge hard so you can work hard. With 30 vacation days and your birthday off, we make sure rest isn't an afterthought.
Urban Sports Club membership
Move, sweat, repeat. We cover your Urban Sports Club membership so you can hit the gym, take a yoga class, or go for a swim – whatever keeps you at your best.
This is how teams work with voize
